output.reason: The NodePool CRD artifacts [ev-760ae3491f13] (v0.37.8) and [ev-09bbe26d2f4a] (v1.0.0) only show "---", so the computed diff text is the only statement of impact. That text says existing NodePool objects stay stored as v1beta1 and keep working, and that the storage migration only needs to happen before a later release removes v1beta1. Nothing fails or is rejected in this release, and no step is required for this upgrade. That matches deprecation (review), not migration-required (mandatory work), so the fact over-claims mandatory work.

correction.statement: The storage version of nodepools.karpenter.sh changes from v1beta1 to v1. Existing NodePool objects stay stored as v1beta1 and keep working. They must be rewritten to v1 before a later release removes v1beta1.

consequence.statement: Existing NodePool objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten, and they keep working in this release. They are expected to break when a later release removes v1beta1, unless they are migrated to v1 storage first.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to a later release that removes v1beta1, run a storage version migration (rewrite all NodePool objects so they are stored as v1). Then update status.storedVersions on the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD.
